fraud_detection_rules.name: High-Value TRANSFER
fraud_detection_rules.description: Detects large fund transfers that are likely money laundering
fraud_detection_rules.rationale: All fraud in the dataset occurs in TRANSFER and CASH_OUT. High-value TRANSFERs are the most common fraud pattern.

fraud_detection_rules.name: High-Value CASH_OUT
fraud_detection_rules.description: Detects large cash-out transactions which often follow fraudulent transfers
fraud_detection_rules.rationale: Money laundering pattern: fraudster transfers funds then cashes out immediately

fraud_detection_rules.name: Account Completely Drained
fraud_detection_rules.description: Sender balance drops to exactly zero after transaction — classic fraud signal
fraud_detection_rules.rationale: 99%+ of fraud cases result in the sender account being drained to ₹0
fraud_detection_rules.false_positive_risk: Low — rarely happens in legitimate transactions

fraud_detection_rules.name: Bank System Flag
fraud_detection_rules.description: Transaction was flagged by the bank's internal system
fraud_detection_rules.rationale: If the bank's own system flagged it, always worth investigating
fraud_detection_rules.false_positive_risk: Low — but note: only catches 0.2% of actual fraud

fraud_detection_rules.name: Very Large Amount Transaction
fraud_detection_rules.description: Any transaction over ₹500,000 regardless of type
fraud_detection_rules.rationale: Unusually large transactions warrant investigation even if not confirmed fraud
fraud_detection_rules.false_positive_risk: High — many large legitimate transactions exist

fraud_detection_rules.name: High-Frequency Account
fraud_detection_rules.description: Same account makes 3 or more transactions within a single hour
fraud_detection_rules.rationale: Fraudsters often send multiple transfers rapidly to launder money
fraud_detection_rules.false_positive_risk: Medium — some business accounts legitimately do this

fraud_detection_rules.name: Zero-Balance Origin Account
fraud_detection_rules.description: Sender had ₹0 before the transaction but still sent money — suspicious
fraud_detection_rules.rationale: Indicates possible synthetic or ghost account used in fraud
fraud_detection_rules.false_positive_risk: Medium — could be a newly opened account
